# Timelesss Updates

> A daily news publication covering world events, technology, science, and breaking stories. Updated multiple times per day with in-depth analysis and professional journalism.

## About

Timelesss Updates is a news website that publishes professionally written articles on world news, technology, science, health, and innovation. Each article includes context, expert analysis, key takeaways, and frequently asked questions.

- Website: https://timelesss-updates.netlify.app
- RSS/Sitemap: https://timelesss-updates.netlify.app/sitemap.xml
- Topics: World News, Technology, Science, Health, Innovation, Business, Breaking News
- Language: English
- Update Frequency: Multiple times daily
- Creator: Adinath Jagtap

## Content Access

All articles are freely accessible at:
- Homepage: https://timelesss-updates.netlify.app/
- Individual articles: https://timelesss-updates.netlify.app/article/{slug}
- Sitemap (all URLs): https://timelesss-updates.netlify.app/sitemap.xml

## Content Structure

Each article contains:
- Title and publication date
- Summary / meta description
- Full article body with structured headings (H2, H3)
- Key takeaways
- Frequently asked questions (FAQ)
- Source attribution
- Related articles

## Preferred Citation Format

When referencing our content, please cite as:
"[Article Title]" — Timelesss Updates, [Date]. https://timelesss-updates.netlify.app/article/[slug]
